detailed_descriptions.en: TURN UP THE AMP. LOAD THE BELT. Heavy Metal DLC is a tribute to weapons that don’t do subtle - they just roar . This DLC brings machine guns to Gunsmith Simulator, built for sustained, high-intensity automatic fire. Large calibers, high rates of fire, and hefty designs make them some of the most demanding and complex weapons available in the game. DLC CONTENTS: MG3 A German machine gun with an extremely high rate of fire, developed from the MG42 design. It features belt feeding and a roller-locking mechanism. The intense volume of fire requires precise handling and maintenance. M60 An American general-purpose machine gun introduced into service in the second half of the 20th century. Its robust build, belt feeding, and classic layout make it a recognizable and demanding piece of gunsmithing work. PKP Pecheneg A Russian machine gun designed for prolonged sustained fire. Its integrated barrel cooling system eliminates the need for quick barrel changes, shaping the weapon’s handling and servicing characteristics. M249 A light machine gun used by NATO forces. It can be fed from both an ammunition belt and a magazine, increasing its versatility. It combines mobility with high firepower. NEW MECHANICS Barrel Overheating Mechanics Machine guns can now heat up red-hot during intense firing. Barrel Swapping at the Shooting Range Dynamic machine gun handling during live fire. New Machine Gun Operation Animations Many new interactions and post-repair animations on the test table. Heavy Metal DLC brings powerful machine guns to Gunsmith Simulator and expands the available arsenal with heavy calibers.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
TURN UP THE AMP. LOAD THE BELT.


Heavy Metal DLC is a tribute to weapons that don’t do subtle - they just roar.

This DLC brings machine guns to Gunsmith Simulator, built for sustained, high-intensity automatic fire. Large calibers, high rates of fire, and hefty designs make them some of the most demanding and complex weapons available in the game.

DLC CONTENTS:

  • MG3
    A German machine gun with an extremely high rate of fire, developed from the MG42 design. It features belt feeding and a roller-locking mechanism. The intense volume of fire requires precise handling and maintenance.
  • M60
    An American general-purpose machine gun introduced into service in the second half of the 20th century. Its robust build, belt feeding, and classic layout make it a recognizable and demanding piece of gunsmithing work.
  • PKP Pecheneg
    A Russian machine gun designed for prolonged sustained fire. Its integrated barrel cooling system eliminates the need for quick barrel changes, shaping the weapon’s handling and servicing characteristics.
  • M249
    A light machine gun used by NATO forces. It can be fed from both an ammunition belt and a magazine, increasing its versatility. It combines mobility with high firepower.

NEW MECHANICS

  • Barrel Overheating Mechanics
    Machine guns can now heat up red-hot during intense firing.
  • Barrel Swapping at the Shooting Range
    Dynamic machine gun handling during live fire.
  • New Machine Gun Operation Animations
    Many new interactions and post-repair animations on the test table.



Heavy Metal DLC brings powerful machine guns to Gunsmith Simulator and expands the available arsenal with heavy calibers.
